symptom: A NativePhone bottom bar whose pages no user role may view (new pages, no grant) passed check, exec and mx check; the app showed its home page with no bottom bar at all (ako/mxcli#2565, mendixlabs/mxcli#1936).
cause: mxbuild writes each BottomBarItem's visibleForRoles from the target page's allowed roles; mendix/native.js keeps an item only when the session has one, and with no items registerPage sets showBottomBar = false. Nothing in mxcli related a bar item to page access.
fix: check -p warns, at security Prototype/Production, for each bar item whose page no user role may view (page allowed module roles intersected with user roles' module roles, project plus the script's grant/revoke/create/alter user role), and once for the bar when that is every item.
insight: A runtime-only consequence (a missing bar, not an error) is found by reading the generated client bundle (deployment/native/index.js) and the client's filter, not the model; once the rule is known, the check is a model join that needs no device. Warn, don't refuse: the model is valid and access may come in a later script.
test: mdl/executor/validate_native_bar_roles_2565_pedapp_test.go (all hidden -> one bar warning; one granted -> one item warning; a module role no user role holds is no viewer; security Off -> silent); failed against a stub; live on TestApp: warns without grants, silent after grant + user role
